{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Subset converted customers
converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check if age differs by channel
print(converted.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean())

# Check if age differs by customer_segment
print(converted.groupby('customer_segment')['customer_age'].mean())"}
